honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not establish claim 4b, AgentsNet external validity, K1 thinking, token scaling curves, larger-model behavior, or LoRA internalization. It is a real-LLM harness smoke plus program reweight registration.
honesty.pilot_limit: The pilot uses K=2 and n=1 with min_recoveries=0 to verify endpoint/runner/checkpoint behavior; it is intentionally not a claim read.
honesty.preflight_limit: The earlier stricter pilot with call_cap=20 and min_recoveries=1 failed preflight because the dry team often hit CALL_CAP; the full sweep needs a non-pilot call_cap before reading K6.
honesty.l0_limit: No new L0 calibration program was run; dry preflight is an in-run feasibility screen only.
honesty.internalization_limit: No training, LoRA, distillation, or register-free test was run.
